title: Georgia waste plant permit upheld despite developer's plan for 97 townhomes
description: A developer in Bartow County, Georgia challenged a permit for a nearby waste processing facility. The county approved the permit despite concerns that it violated zoning restrictions. The developer argued that their planned townhomes should receive protection under existing zoning laws. However, the court found that the definitions of residential dwellings applied only to already constructed buildings. Ultimately, the appeals court upheld the permit, allowing the waste facility to operate.

They promised Afghan women freedom, delivered bans: Inside five years of Taliban rule
description: Under Taliban governance since August 2021, Afghanistan is grappling with severe rollbacks in women's rights and education. Over 2.6 million girls are deprived of secondary school education, and women's public engagement is significantly curtailed. The international community is alarmed by these developments, as restrictions on women’s employment further hinder access to healthcare. A report by UNESCO and UNICEF emphasizes the urgent decline in educational standards among Afghan youth.

title: Jaypal Malviya secures India's first LA 2028 shooting quota with ISSF Worlds silver
description: Jaypal Malviya announced his talent by winning a silver medal at the ISSF World Championships. His performance earned India its first shooting quota for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics. Malviya had qualified for the final in third place and showed resilience during tense moments. He previously made a mark by winning gold in national trials and has since equipped himself for future competitions.

Despite the recent recovery, the Nifty50 and Sensex remain down 6.1% and 6.9%, respectively, in 2026.

description: India's hockey team clinched an impressive victory, capturing the men's Asian Champions Trophy against Japan. Despite falling behind initially, the players rallied to turn the tide, with Shilanand Lakra, Dilpreet Singh, Jugraj Singh, and Vivek Sagar Prasad each scoring vital goals. Japan's early lead was met with India's unwavering spirit, culminating in the team's sixth title in the tournament's history.

title: UP teen calls child helpline to stop her marriage to 25-yr-old Saudi Arabia-based man
description: A 16-year-old girl in Ballia intervened to stop her arranged marriage to a 25-year-old man. The girl contacted the Child Helpline, revealing her underage status and impending wedding. Officials, accompanied by local police, assisted in counseling her family regarding the legal ramifications of child marriage. After discussions, both families agreed to cancel the wedding and signed undertakings to comply with the law.

description: Dickens wrote of the spring of hope and the winter of despair as two seasons belonging to the same age. The American electorate witnessed both in November 2026. Mamdani chose hope. Ramaswamy chose despair. And the results suggested which had proved more persuasive.

title: What I have learnt is that I should not think so much ahead: Prithvi Shaw
description: Prithvi Shaw scored an unbeaten 53 runs to guide Maharashtra to a 10-wicket win over Bengal. After shifting from Mumbai, he enjoys leading Maharashtra in the Ranji Trophy match. Shaw emphasised the importance of focusing on immediate tasks rather than thinking ahead about his return to the national team. He expressed confidence in achieving big runs with more consistent performances in forthcoming innings.

India eyes new $800m BrahMos deal as Philippines boosts defences against China
description: India is reportedly nearing a new defense deal with the Philippines for almost 60 BrahMos missiles. The potential agreement is estimated to be worth between $700 million to $800 million. Manila's interest comes as the country seeks to modernize its military and enhance coastal defenses against China. Philippine officials have conveyed their intention to acquire additional BrahMos missile systems from India.

title: 'Memory of the World': Rajatarangini, Mahabharata & Arthashastra get UN recognition
description: Three significant works from India's literary heritage have been added to Unesco's Memory of the World Regional Register. Kalhana's 'Rajatarangini', the 'Mahabharata', and Kautilya's 'Arthashastra' received this recognition recently. These inscriptions reflect various aspects of India's intellectual traditions, including historical writing and governance. This announcement follows India's previous regional register recognitions in 2024 for other literary works. The initiative aims to preserve and digitise India's manuscript heritage for future generations.

title: '14 to 114': PM Modi hails para-athletes after historic Asian Para Games medal haul
description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi acknowledged the remarkable success of India's para-athletes at the 2026 Asian Para Games, where they earned a historic total of 114 medals, including 30 golds. He urged this triumph to be a stepping stone toward even greater achievements in the upcoming 2028 Los Angeles Paralympics, underscoring the strides made in India's para-sports since 2010.

title: Israel govt formation: In big setback for Netanyahu, Arab parties back Eisenkot
description: Israeli Arab parties are considering backing an opposition coalition to challenge Prime Minister Netanyahu’s leadership. Ahmad Tibi has expressed openness to support without formally joining the new government. This election has resulted in a fragmented Knesset lacking a decisive majority. Opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot has set specific conditions for engaging with Arab factions, marking a noteworthy evolution in the historical dynamics between Arab representatives and Israeli governance.

title: Trump effect: US-based Indian techies are returning, but to what?
description: Techies returning from the US are getting into a wide range of tech and techno-functional roles across the board. Employers in India are also increasingly looking for specialised skills rather than treating international work experience as an advantage in itself. So, the important question then is: what are these techies returning to? Are there enough roles to absorb their talent? And, what about the salary levels?

title: Tyreek Hill’s NFL comeback faces major hurdle as teams assess his recovery
description: Tyreek Hill remains an unrestricted free agent after his release from the Miami Dolphins, making him available to sign with any NFL team without draft pick compensation. However, his return remains uncertain due to a serious knee injury suffered in 2025. Despite interest from playoff contenders, teams want complete medical clearance and private workouts before committing to the eight-time Pro Bowler.

title: Jeff Bezos' ex-wife $30 mn donation gets 10 yr affordable housing plan in Bay Area
description: Housing Trust Silicon Valley has unveiled an ambitious 10-year initiative aimed at improving affordable housing in the Bay Area. With a generous $30 million backing from MacKenzie Scott, this plan seeks to bolster homeownership initiatives and forge stronger alliances with policy advocacy. The focus is on maximizing current funding and attracting new resources to create and maintain affordable housing for the community over the next decade.

title: Why blue wave won't wash away US immigration, visa woes of Indians
description: As Democrats gain control of both chambers of Congress, they are poised to scrutinize immigration policies more closely. However, the enduring executive powers from the Trump era pose challenges for immediate reforms. Policy shifts will likely be dictated by court decisions instead of congressional mandates due to the presidential veto power.

title: Kia dealer delays delivery of Rs 39L Carnival; commission awards Rs 2.33L to customer
description: After placing an order for a Kia Carnival, a company experienced significant setbacks when the dealer failed to deliver on time. This delay resulted in considerable financial losses. The commission found the dealer guilty of inadequate service while clearing Kia India of any blame. As a remedy, the dealer was mandated to return the booking fee with interest, plus cover legal fees and compensation for the impacted company.

The initiative welcomed 60 members of the Boys & Girls Clubs of Greater Kansas City, offering them outfits for special occasions. Players Hailie Mace, Gabrielle Robinson and Nichelle Prince also joined the event, which focused on confidence and self-expression.
